title: Pure Charmer
summary: Charmer, Channeler, Familiar-Possessed and Possessed cards with generic staples. It's built around the 2026 support: Spellbook of the Grand Circle adds four Charmers of different Attributes and later Fusion Summons Charmers of the Grand Circle, Spiritual Art Familiars searches the Possessed Spells and Traps, and Possessed Destiny summons a Charmer from the Deck. One copy of each original Charmer keeps the Attribute spread the Grand Circle cards count.

allow.Spellbook of the Grand Circle: Named for the Spellbooks, but it's Charmer support: it adds four Charmers and Fusion Summons with Charmer and Familiar-Possessed monsters.
allow.Spiritual Power Recovery Potion: Always treated as a Possessed card.

main: Spiritual Art Familiars
Newest support. On summon, searches a Possessed Spell/Trap or Grand Spiritual Art - Ichirin; can change its own Type and Attribute; destroyed: summons a Spellcaster with 1500 DEF from the Deck or GY.
Wynn the Wind Channeler
Discard it with another WIND monster to search a WIND monster with 1500 or less DEF. Counts as a Charmer.
Hiita the Fire Channeler
Discard it with another FIRE monster to search a FIRE monster with higher ATK. Counts as a Charmer.
Eria the Water Channeler
Discard it with another WATER monster to search a WATER monster of equal or higher Level. Counts as a Charmer.
Aussa the Earth Channeler
Discard it with an EARTH monster to search an EARTH monster of the same Type. Counts as a Charmer.
Aussa the Earth Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing EARTH monster while face-up. One of each Charmer keeps the Attribute spread for Spellbook of the Grand Circle.
Eria the Water Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing WATER monster while face-up.
Hiita the Fire Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing FIRE monster while face-up.
Wynn the Wind Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing WIND monster while face-up.
Lyna the Light Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing LIGHT monster while face-up.
Dharc the Dark Charmer
FLIP: takes control of an opposing DARK monster while face-up.
Familiar-Possessed - Lyna
Summoned from the hand or Deck by sending Lyna and a LIGHT monster; then searches a Spellcaster with 1500 DEF.
Familiar-Possessed - Dharc
Summoned from the hand or Deck by sending Dharc and a DARK monster; then searches a Level 3 or 4 LIGHT Spellcaster.
Awakening of the Possessed - Rasenryu
Summoned from the hand or Deck by sending a Spellcaster and a WIND monster; returns an opposing card to the hand. Leaving the field: searches a Possessed Spell/Trap.
Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte
Summoned from the hand or Deck by sending a Spellcaster and a WATER monster; discards a random card from the opponent's hand. Leaving the field: searches a Possessed Spell/Trap.
Spellbook of the Grand Circle

Newest support. Adds four Charmers with different Attributes from the Deck, GY or banishment, then shuffles two cards back. From the GY: Fusion Summons with Charmer and Familiar-Possessed monsters, and the opponent can't respond.
Spirit Charmers
Discard a card to take two different Charmers, Familiar-Possessed monsters or Possessed Spells/Traps from the Deck: one to the hand, one Set.
Possessed Destiny
Newest support. Special Summons a Charmer or Familiar-Possessed from the hand, Deck or GY with the same Attribute as a face-up monster.
Grand Spiritual Art - Ichirin
Field Spell: negates the opponent's first monster effect each turn while you control a Spellcaster with 1500 DEF, and fetches Spiritual Art Familiars by revealing a Spellcaster.
Awakening of the Possessed
Draws a card when a Spellcaster with 1850 ATK is summoned, and protects Charmers from destruction by card effects.
Spiritual Power Recovery Potion
Newest support. From the GY: Special Summons any number of Spellcasters with different Attributes from the hand.
Possessed Partnerships
Revives or summons a Spellcaster with 1500 DEF, then destroys a face-up card if you control two Attributes.
Unpossessed
Charmers can't be destroyed by battle; when your monster is destroyed, summons a Spellcaster with 1500 DEF of another Attribute from the Deck.
extra: Newest support. Fusion of 2+ Charmers or Familiar-Possessed: one effect per Attribute used, from searching a Possessed card to bouncing a card or reviving a Spellcaster.
Newest support. Fusion of a Spellcaster and a WIND monster: steals an opposing monster, and on the opponent's turn sends two cards to the bottom of the Deck.
Newest support. Link-4 that gains ATK per Attribute on the field and revives two monsters that share an Attribute or a Type.
Link-2 with an EARTH monster: summons an EARTH monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
Link-2 with a WATER monster: summons a WATER monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
Link-2 with a FIRE monster: summons a FIRE monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
Link-2 with a WIND monster: summons a WIND monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
Link-2 with a LIGHT monster: summons a LIGHT monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
Link-2 with a DARK monster: summons a DARK monster from the opponent's GY; searches when destroyed.
